latest.notes:
Retires 'Keep away from the same time of day'.

It did the same job as the day-to-day hour spacing added in 0.6.14, and less well: anything within 90 minutes is within 5 hours, so it could never do anything on its own unless you set the spacing to 0 or 1. Dayparting is now one control instead of two.

The spacing rule looks three days either side rather than about one, it sees days you have already built, and it holds on longer when a rotation is tight. Set it to 0 if you want the old same-clock-hour behaviour.

Scheduler ▸ Scheduler Settings… no longer carries its own copy of the setting; it points at Settings ▸ Scheduling, where dayparting lives.
